Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>It is a reaction card, right ? So, I get Rushed, I intercept and Smasher,
>the Bone-breaking Rusher shuts his mlouth and goes back to bed.
>
>What if I don't intercept, just let the rush action continue : can I still
>react with Obedience ?

Yes and yes. Obedience is usable if you block an action and are entering combat
*or* whether you're just getting attacked. (Assuming in both cases that you can
play Reaction cards. Need to be untapped or have played Wake/FA).

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sten During wrote:
> Block, Majesty (at superior) at which time the acting minion plays
> Psyche. Question that arose was if Obediance was legal at this time
> or not.

It's legal. But the blocking minion is tapped, so cannot play
reaction cards (like Obedience) unless some other effect (like
Wake) allows it.

Messages.Author: Marty
Messages.Body:
Sten During <ya...@netg.se> wrote in message news:<3CCE6B9B...@netg.se>...


My gut says no, you can't do this, however, looking at the card text,
I reckon you can:
Psyche! (in part) 'Only usable at the end of a combat when both
combatants are still ready. Enter combat with the opposing minion.
This is a new combat.'
Obedience 'Only usable when this reacting vampire is about to enter
combat with an acting younger vampire. [dom] This vampire is not
tapped and combat does not occur; untap the acting vampire. The acting
vampire is blocked and cannot attempt the same action this turn. [DOM]
As above, but do not untap the acting vampire.

It's probably a close call, but I don't see why not...

Marty

played at superior, with the reacting vampire untapping. Does the untap happen
before Psyche restarts combat? I would guess it would have to, since previous
rulings have stressed that a card's effects happen all together and are never
split by other effects. However, it has also been ruled that other effects on
a combat ends strike happen after combat. Help?
